BiblicalUsage: 1) to move away, backslide, move, go, turn back; 1a) (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to displace, move back; 1b2) to remove, carry away; 1d) (Hophal) to be driven back, be moved back
